name: Palace of Fine Arts, first floor

source.description: Interior reconstruction traced from the official PFA Master Floorplan, page 1: https://palaceoffinearts.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2025/04/PFA-Master-Floorplan.pdf (accessed 2026-10-25). North up. Approximate scale retained from OpenStreetMap (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, 273.8 m overall span. Interior walls, door positions and room footprints are hand-traced; heights (8 m shell / 3 m partitions) and wall thicknesses are illustrative, not surveyed. Ground floor only; mezzanine not modeled. Restricted areas are labeled, not verified public routes.
